content:
**Slow Metabolizer** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Increased percentage of hunger satisfaction when eating food.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | All food satisfies hunger by an additional 100%. | 0002936F | 
| ★ | 1 | All food satisfies hunger by an additional 50%. | 00029330 | 

Before update 60, the perk had 3 ranks that increased hunger satisfaction by 25%/50%/75%.
